data.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
data.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
data.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.
data.versionDescription:
SpotiFLAC 5.1.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.1.0-ios-unsigned

### New Features

- **library**: Expand audio format and ReplayGain filters
- **player**: Warn when muted and allow manual resume
- **native**: Add cancellable data workers and streamed file hashing
- **playback**: Automate mute and headphone playback controls
- **player**: Show mixing status beside audio quality
- **automix**: Add configurable duration and transition effects
- **lyrics**: Add staggered spring motion to visible rows
- **build**: Require Discord in production and keep Lite opt-in
- **settings**: Default to built-in playback and word-synced lyrics
- **network**: Add SMB and WebDAV libraries with streaming and uploads
- **statistics**: Show cover artwork and artists for top tracks
- **mornye**: Restore liquid glass with continuous draggable navigation
- **discord**: Add opt-in mobile rich presence with track artwork
- **extensions**: Support personal account forms and direct downloads
- **playback**: Add local listening statistics and annual recap
- **library**: Show recent releases from favorite artists
- **library**: Add batch playlist and queue actions
- **library**: Filter albums with missing tracks

### Bug Fixes

- **repo**: Retry initialization before adding a registry
- **storage**: Preserve extension encryption keys on read failures
- **extensions**: Retain packages with unreadable settings
- **downloads**: Finalize album ReplayGain after history is saved
- **downloads**: Preserve actual provider audio format
- **lyrics**: Treat placeholder zero timestamps as unsynced
- **library**: Retry transient SQLite locks before scan transactions
- **riverpod**: Remove public notifier getters

- **logs**: Retain polling ownership across restart and clear
- **network**: Close request-owned HTTP clients reliably
- **backup**: Close archive outputs when extraction fails

- **network**: Discard stale folder browsing responses
- **downloads**: Recover queue ownership after setup failures
- **playlists**: Serialize collection changes and isolate domain models
- **history**: Serialize mutations and preserve newer file metadata

- **library**: Distinguish unavailable storage from missing files

- **library**: Remove deleted files from both library indexes
- **downloads**: Preserve filenames after decryption and conversion
- **glass**: Refract navbar icons through the held lens
